name: Synthetic differential metabolomics demo
purpose: Software behavior, schema, and user-interface demonstration only
provenance: Hand-authored fictional values; not derived from participants, specimens, publications, or clinical records

columns.log2FC: Signed base-2 log fold change for the simulated contrast
columns.pvalue: Illustrative unadjusted p-value used to exercise BH correction

limitations: Values are intentionally illustrative and cannot support biological, diagnostic, or clinical claims.
Pathway labels are simplified software fixtures rather than a curated ontology.
The demo contains no raw spectra, participant data, or sample identifiers.
